title: Legal Per-Se BAC Thresholds: Adult Operator (0.08% / 0.05% UT), Commercial CDL (0.04%), and Under-21 Zero Tolerance

single_bulb_signal.note: Three roadside signals each show only top red lens lit, other lenses dark.

scene_match.note: Shows 3-tier comparison with gauges plus right-column icons for sedan, 18-wheeler, and graduate with card, matching prompt.

result.summary: Despite passing visual rules and matching icons, gauges invert strictness with commercial needle higher than adult, teaching opposite of CDL 0.04 stricter than adult.

teaching_correct.note: Commercial middle gauge shows higher needle/ larger red zone than adult top gauge, implying CDL allows more alcohol when CDL 0.04 is stricter than adult 0.08; teaches thresholds backwards.
